messages.text: Partner PAR returns invalid_request, all params validated.
Check JWKS reachability and TLS cipher suite — both surface as invalid_request on PAR.
JWKS was behind their VPN. Fixed.

outcome: JWKS endpoint was not publicly reachable.

outcome: Partner switched to DPoP authorization scheme.
